text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe told reporters in London on Sunday the private sector and government officials were scheduled to meet in Harare to agree on the establishment of a joint commission on technical co-operation between his southern African country and Cyprus, where he was recently on a state visit.

- The campaign to get non-resident Zimbabweans interested in investing back home is gathering pace with the country's nationals living in neighbouring Botswana warming up to the proposals at the weekend.
